results.1: A steady wind sweeps across the open grasslands, sending great waves through the tall golden grasses. The landscape seems to move like an immense inland sea.
results.2: The shallow waters of a stream wind between banks of reddish earth. Broad deposits of smooth stones mark the much wider course it occupies during the spring rains.
results.3: A vast herd of cattle moves slowly across the distant plains, accompanied by mounted drovers. A cloud of reddish dust hangs above the herd, visible from miles away.
results.4: A solitary tree stands atop a low hill, its branches bent permanently in the direction of the prevailing wind. A handful of birds shelter among its leaves.
results.5: The sun has baked the exposed earth into a mosaic of cracked red clay. Hardy grasses emerge wherever the soil retains even a little moisture.
results.6: Several wild horses gallop across the plain in the distance. They briefly disappear into a shallow depression before emerging again along the crest of a hill.
results.7: You pass a seemingly endless fence of rough-hewn posts and wooden rails. Beyond it, livestock graze among the grasses, occasionally lifting their heads to watch you.
results.8: A broad sandstone outcrop rises from the surrounding plains, its layered sides glowing a deep orange in the sunlight. Weathering has sculpted its uppermost rocks into rounded pillars.
results.9: A small prairie fox pauses among the grasses, its ears twitching toward you. It disappears with a sudden flash of its bushy tail.
results.10: The remains of a stone corral stand upon a gentle rise. Its weathered walls are considerably older than the newer timber fences scattered throughout the region.
results.11: A distant ranchstead is surrounded by grazing livestock, outbuildings, and several large water troughs. The creaking of a wooden wind-driven water pump carries faintly across the plain.
results.12: Thunderheads accumulate along the horizon, their dark undersides contrasting sharply with the sunlit grasslands. Occasional flashes of lightning illuminate the distant hills.
results.13: The grasses give way to a broad patch of flowering clover and bright yellow blossoms. The air hums with countless bees moving between them.
results.14: Several mounted herders tend a flock upon the distant slopes. Their brightly colored blankets and the arrangements of their pack animals distinguish them from the Cadorian ranchers nearer town.
results.15: Small burrowing animals stand upright beside their holes, issuing sharp warning calls to one another. They retreat underground as you draw nearer.
results.16: A row of old standing stones follows the crest of a ridge. Their surfaces are weathered smooth, and their shadows stretch across the grasses in the afternoon light.
results.17: A freight wagon moves slowly along a distant trail, its canvas cover billowing in the wind. Its progress is marked by a thin ribbon of red dust.
results.18: As evening approaches, the grasslands take on a deep amber hue. The low sun seems impossibly large as it sinks beneath the uninterrupted horizon.
results.19: Tiny golden motes rise from a patch of tall grass, drifting upon the breeze like airborne embers. They gradually fade as they are carried farther from the plants.
results.20: From the crest of a hill, you can see miles of uninterrupted rolling country. Scattered herds, distant homesteads, and the occasional ribbon of water are the only interruptions in the immense expanse of grassland.
